evidence_policy.workflow: A workflow survives as evidence-backed only when a Crucible blind A/B run beats a no-skill baseline on at least two representative fixtures; every result states the fixture count and trials per cell.
evidence_policy.operations: A narrow live operations contract may survive without A/B evidence only when it names a concrete live system, command, protocol, or product boundary that ordinary guidance cannot replace.
evidence_policy.guidance: Merged guidance is not represented as an independent workflow claim; it is retained only as routed reference material or a composition layer.

baseline-ui.basis: UI hygiene reference; no independent workflow claim.

ci.basis: Gate-selection guidance composed with repository-owned checks.

code-review.basis: Crucible blind A/B sweep retained the skill after paired defect-detection wins.

evidence.limits: One worker trial per arm and one grader family; proxy result is unanchored.

compound.basis: Closeout and retrieval guidance, not a standalone outcome claim.

council.basis: Model-perspective composition guidance routed by the decision lane.
